title: TDS on Rent: When Tenants Must Deduct 2% and How to File Form 141 (Earlier 26QC)
seoTitle: TDS on Rent Paid by Tenant: 2% Rule, Form 141 (Old 26QC)
seoDescription: Tenants paying over ₹50,000 a month must deduct 2% TDS once a year. From 1 April 2026 it is section 393 and Form 141, replacing 194-IB and Form 26QC.
excerpt: Old 194-IB and Form 26QC versus the new section 393 and Form 141, an 11-month lease worked out in rupees, late fees and interest, and the portal steps to deposit the tax and get the certificate.
